Frequently asked questions

What's included in a full brand identity project?

A full brand identity includes brand strategy, naming (if needed), logo design, visual identity system, typography, colour palette, tone of voice, and comprehensive brand guidelines.

Do you design logos only?

Logo design is part of our offering, but we always deliver it as part of a full visual identity system — not in isolation.

How long does a brand project take?

A typical brand identity project runs 4-8 weeks from discovery to final deliverables, depending on scope.

Do you create brand guidelines?

Absolutely. We create comprehensive brand guidelines that ensure consistency across all channels and touchpoints.
